plan_details.teaching_learning_resources: Pictures/  videos  showing  effects of  acids or  alkalis on  food, laboratory  apparatus  and  chemical  reagents,  heat  sources,  food items
plan_details.references: TIE(2025)Food and Nutrition for advance level secondary school form six. Tanzania insitute of education. Daresaalam

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks: “How can you tell bacterial colonies apart? What features do you observe?”
teaching_structure.learning_activities: List size, shape, colour, margin.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Laboratory analysis to determine spoilage microorganisms in food is well conducted

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Demonstrates Gram staining and catalase test. Students observe colony morphology on their plates.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: In groups, describe colony characteristics. Perform Gram stain and catalase test. Identify likely genera.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Laboratory analysis to determine spoilage microorganisms in food is well conducted

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Task: “Write a full laboratory report including aim, method, results, discussion, and conclusion on the spoilage organisms found.”
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Compile report using provided template. Submit for assessment.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Laboratory analysis to determine spoilage microorganisms in food is well conducted

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Use portfolios, performance assessment, and questions and answers, flash card question, group discussions, guide class research and presentation.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Students  present portfolio, answer questions orally and perform tasks, respond to flash cards questions.
